gpu_status: 0 M10 forwards; 5244 calls / 41 batches under the standing GPU authorization
model: kev-4B (runner module f118ea59: identity, source, loader); L11 = Qwen3.5 full attention, 16 query heads x 256 in 4 KV groups, output gate, o_proj without bias

preregistered_analysis.C: C(arm) = median over cells of dM_main - dM_round
preregistered_analysis.S: S(arm) = #cells where the donor-new-source patch is JOINT and the donor-ROUND-source patch of the same arm is not (target host new)
preregistered_analysis.SPEC: SPEC iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
preregistered_analysis.SUF: SUF(arm) iff S(arm) >= 1/2 S(full) and SPEC(arm)
preregistered_analysis.always_reported: S, SPEC, J_main, J_round, median dM and C per arm; per host; leave-one-donor-group-out of every verdict; energy shares, alpha, capped and zero-part shares of the head slices, positions and contrast parts; the S of each random frame; change norm of every arm relative to full
preregistered_analysis.consistency_gate: full = the M3 all-heads patch: its 208 rows equal M3's bitwise and S(full) = 51; meanD_host = the M6 pooled-donor arm: its 208 rows equal M6's bitwise and S = 39 (GPU, checked in the run); cs1 / chW / ch10 / chR / cpar16_sm / cperp16_sm / crand16_sm = the M9 arms (same patch fields): their 7 x 208 rows equal M9's bitwise and S = 39 / 39 / 25 / 0 / 27 / 39 / 7; otherwise every verdict is INCONSISTENT_WITH_M3_M6_M9 and no claim
preregistered_analysis.contrast_subspace_verdict: on the M9 rows cpar16_sm / cperp16_sm (replayed bitwise): CONTRAST_IN_COMMON_SUBSPACE iff SUF(cpar16_sm) and not SUF(cperp16_sm); CONTRAST_OUTSIDE_COMMON_SUBSPACE iff SUF(cperp16_sm) and not SUF(cpar16_sm); CONTRAST_BOTH_PARTS iff both; CONTRAST_NOT_SPLITTABLE iff neither; suffix _UNRESOLVED on the first three iff SPLIT_NULL5 fails. The M9 one-seed verdict stays as reported in M9
preregistered_analysis.gain_tfine_verdict: t* = the smallest t in 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1 with SUF(g{t}_1) (cs1 at t = 1); GAIN_TFINE:t*, or GAIN_TFINE_NONE; S, C and J per t and per host reported
preregistered_analysis.heads_sm_verdict: on cs1 with c restricted to a head slice and rescaled to ||c|| per row and span position: CONTRAST_SM_IN_WRITER_HEADS iff SUF(chW_sm) and not SUF(chR_sm); CONTRAST_SM_OUTSIDE_WRITER_HEADS iff SUF(chR_sm) and not SUF(chW_sm); CONTRAST_SM_EITHER_HEAD_SET iff both; CONTRAST_SM_NEEDS_ALL_HEADS iff neither. Suffix +H10 iff SUF(ch10_sm); suffix +WX10 iff SUF(chWx10_sm) (the writer heads without head 10)
preregistered_analysis.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: CONTRAST_SM_IN_WRITER_HEADS: at the size of c, the writer heads' slice carries the contrast's effect and the other heads' slice does not, so the M9 head result is not an energy effect; +H10: head 10's slice alone suffices at matched size; +WX10: the writer heads without head 10 suffice. CONTRAST_AT_P29: the contrast acts at the position whose token ROUND changes; CONTRAST_AT_P30: at the next position. SHIFT_AT_CONTRAST_POSITIONS: the common shift is needed only where the contrast is (a local gate); SHIFT_AT_OTHER_POSITIONS: the shift acts through the earlier positions (context read by later layers); SHIFT_NEEDS_ALL_POSITIONS: neither part suffices alone. SPLIT_NULL5 failing means a contrast-sized push in a random 16-dim direction often repairs, and the M9 split verdict stays unresolved. GAIN_TFINE:t: the smallest common shift on the 0.1 grid at which the contrast at s = 1 repairs. All M10 arms except full are pooled-donor arms (effectively 8 host replicates, 3 responding in M9); per-host S is the honest unit. The position arms are not size-matched (position 29 holds most of c's energy)
preregistered_analysis.position_verdict: on cs1 with c kept only at one span position (not size-matched; energy shares reported): CONTRAST_AT_P29 iff SUF(cpos29) and not SUF(cpos30); CONTRAST_AT_P30 iff SUF(cpos30) and not SUF(cpos29); CONTRAST_AT_EITHER_POSITION iff both; CONTRAST_NEEDS_BOTH_POSITIONS iff neither
preregistered_analysis.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run capture of host new)
preregistered_analysis.shift_location_verdict: the common shift (t = 1) applied only at span positions 29-30 (sh2930) or only at 0-28 (sh0_28), with the full c: SHIFT_AT_CONTRAST_POSITIONS iff SUF(sh2930) and not SUF(sh0_28); SHIFT_AT_OTHER_POSITIONS iff SUF(sh0_28) and not SUF(sh2930); SHIFT_AT_EITHER iff both; SHIFT_NEEDS_ALL_POSITIONS iff neither
preregistered_analysis.size_gate: head-slice arms _sm: per row and span position where the slice is nonzero and alpha < cap, the rescaled slice has norm ||c|| within 1e-3 relative (fail-closed in the runner); alpha = min(||c|| / ||slice||, 10); the pre-rescale slice energy share, alpha and the capped share are recorded. Random frames: as M9 (no cap)
preregistered_analysis.split_null_multi: SPLIT_NULL5 holds iff the median S over the 5 random frames (crand16_sm = M9's seed and crand16_sm_s1 .. s4) is <= 5 and none of them is SPEC; each S and the maximum are reported
preregistered_analysis.units: the 104 cross-group cells of M1-M6; cells share donors and hosts, and the pooled-mean arms vary with the donor only through the pool exclusion (effectively 8 hosts), so counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests; per-host S is always reported
